name: Clear Powder Snow - No Freeze Overlay
summary: Removes the frost overlay so you can still see where you are going while freezing.
body:
**Clear Powder Snow - No Freeze Overlay** is a client-side resource pack for Minecraft Java Edition. It changes one specific thing about the vanilla look, and nothing else.

### What it changes
- The frost / ice overlay drawn around the edges of the screen is removed
- Nothing else changes - freezing, damage and the slow effect all work as in vanilla

### Why players use it
- You can find the way out of powder snow instead of being blinded by frost
- Handy in snowy biomes and for exploring mountains

### Install
1. Download the `.zip` file from this page (do not unzip it).
2. Drop it into `.minecraft/resourcepacks` - or use the CurseForge app.
3. Enable it in **Options → Resource Packs** and move it to the top of the list.

Works on Minecraft **1.21.x** (Java Edition) and on most launchers. Client-side only: it works on any server, and no one else needs it.

---
